name: pi-codemode-guard
description: Pi extension that compiles LLM codemode scripts into pi's QuickJS-sandbox JavaScript: adds missing await, strips markdown fences, converts JSON tool-call programs, and translates OpenCode, Codex, Cloudflare, TanStack, Vercel, DeepSeek PTC dialects
